comment: Follow-up timing and unique scripts for cold outreach sequences. Intervals are in days after the previous email.

steps.label: Initial Outreach
steps.script_template:
Hi {first_name},

I came across {company} and noticed {hook}.

We work with {persona_type} teams to {value_prop_short}. Given {pain_point}, I thought there might be a fit.

{cta}

Best,
Susanta

steps.label: First Follow-up
steps.script_template:
Hi {first_name},

Just wanted to bump this up in case it got buried.

In one line — we help {persona_type} teams {value_prop_short} without the usual {objection}.

Worth a 15-minute call this week?

Best,
Susanta

steps.label: Value Add Follow-up
steps.subject_template: Something that might be useful for {company}
steps.script_template:
Hi {first_name},

I'll keep this short — I know you're busy.

We recently helped a {industry} company similar to {company} solve {pain_point}. The result was {outcome_example}.

I'd be happy to share how we did it. Would a quick call this week work?

Best,
Susanta

steps.label: Final Break-up
steps.script_template:
Hi {first_name},

I'll take the hint — clearly the timing isn't right, and that's completely fine.

I'll close the loop here. If {company}'s needs around {pain_area} change in the future, I'd welcome the chance to reconnect.

All the best,
Susanta

P.S. If you'd like to refer someone who might benefit, I'd really appreciate it.

steps.label: Soft Re-open
steps.script_template:
Hi {first_name},

We spoke a while back about {pain_area} at {company}.

I wanted to check back in — things move quickly and the situation may have changed.

Are you still working on this? Happy to pick up where we left off.

Best,
Susanta

steps.label: Trigger Follow-up
steps.script_template:
Hi {first_name},

Quick note — {recent_news_or_hook}.

Given that context, I thought our previous conversation about {pain_area} might be worth revisiting.

Open to a brief call?

Best,
Susanta
